what_is_computed_here: Reads T_claim_peer_rank.csv, takes all Korean rows and all global rows for each peer group, computes simple unweighted means, subtracts Korean mean minus global mean, and counts Korean fallback firms.
known_caveat: Gap is computed over all Korean firm rows already present in T_claim_peer_rank, so any fallback row directly moves the published gap.

what_is_computed_here: Firm-level composite inputs used by the final gap table: dreamus=50.000000 eligible_mean, kakao_ent=33.333333 all_row_mean_fallback, spotify=25.074689 eligible_mean.
known_caveat: Korean mean is the simple average of dreamus and kakao_ent, while the only global peer is spotify.

what_is_computed_here: For each firm, uses rank-eligible rows when present; otherwise falls back to all observed rows. Then averages selected country-cell composites into one firm-level composite_narrow.
known_caveat: kakao_ent has no rank-eligible row, so its firm composite enters via all_row_mean_fallback.

what_is_computed_here: Country-cell composite_narrow values feeding the peer-rank table: dreamus=50.000000, kakao_ent=33.333333, spotify=25.074689.
known_caveat: dreamus and spotify are two-axis partial composites; kakao_ent is a one-axis market-only composite.

what_is_computed_here: Constructs composite_narrow by equal-weighting only observed narrow axes, sets rank_eligible=yes only when observed_count>=2, and marks thin coverage when only one axis is observed.
known_caveat: reg_narrow is missing for all three firms; kakao_ent also lacks risk_narrow, so its composite equals a single observed market axis.
